correctness.rationale: The crown Laplacian splits into constant symmetric, constant antisymmetric, zero-sum symmetric and zero-sum antisymmetric eigenspaces, with eigenvalues 0,2(n−1),n,n−2. Projection of oriented edge vectors gives the displayed K_m bilinear kernel for m=1,2. Applying the rank-two Woodbury identity on the constants-orthogonal subspace expresses damage as 4n((1−R)Q+rq)/((1−R)²−r²). Recomputed the four orbit-specific K_1/K_2 formulas symbolically and independently simplified them to each displayed rational Δ_I,Δ_R,Δ_L,Δ_D. The displayed factors 1−R±r are strictly positive n≥4 by shifting n=t+4, proving connectivity. Symmetric permutations of matched labels and part exchange reduce all unordered pairs to the four exhaustive orbit representatives. Exact difference factorizations have positive shifted coefficients for I>D, I>R, R>L and D>L; the only sign change D−R has numerator −4p(n) with p(n)=n³−14n²+34n−12, p(4)..p(11)<0, p(12+t)=t³+22t²+130t+108>0 for t≥0. Exact symbolic recomputation and rational sample comparisons support, but do not substitute for, the all-n proof. An incident pair is uniquely specified by its shared vertex and two distinct incident edges, giving 2n·C(n−1,2)=n(n−1)(n−2).
